newsitem.title: USA: Lennar makes SEC filing for spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Lennar makes SEC filing for spinoff.

text.p: Lennar Corp said on Friday its subsidiary, LNR Property Corp, has made a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission to register its common stock under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 to fulfill a requirement for its spinoff.
Lennar said that it previously announced the spinoff of LNR, a real estate investment and management business, to shareholders.
Lennar will continue to own and operate its homebuilding business and related businesses, the company said in a statement.
LNR was originally named LPC Inc, but changed its name to LNR Property Corp, Lennar said.
Lennar, which is merging with Pacific Greystone Corp, said the proposed Revenue Reconciliation Act of 1997 would not affect the tax free status of the spin-off.
The company filed for an Internal Revenue Service ruling on the proposed spin off on April 11, 1997, Lennar said.
The proposed tax legislation states it will not apply to requests submitted before April 16, 1997, Lennar said.
